title: Quantum Dynamic Time Warping for Multivariate Time Series Classification
summary: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a cornerstone for time series classification, but its reliance on Euclidean distances fails to capture latent cross-channel correlations in complex multivariate data. We propose a hybrid Quantum Dynamic Time Warping (qDTW) architecture, replacing the classical distance metric with the parameterized geometry of a quantum Hilbert space. Through structural ablation on benchmarks up to $C=8$ spatial dimensions, we establish fundamental topological rules for quantum sequence alignment.
